name: pitroom
description: A free pit crew for your expensive coding agent: delegate research, fixes, tests and parallel investigations to cheap OpenCode, Codex or Claude Code workers, with verified answers, exact diffs and cost receipts.

interface.longDescription: Pitroom lets your coding agent hand bounded work to OpenCode, Codex or Claude Code workers running your own free, paid or local models: read-only research, isolated code changes, second-opinion reviews and parallel crews, with per-run permission profiles, a git guard, verified file references, exact diffs and cost receipts. Fourteen skills adapt a full development workflow (brainstorm, plan, worker-driven development, review, debugging, TDD, verification). Requires the pitroom command (npm i -g pitroom), Node.js 18 or newer and at least one worker CLI.
